cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a craftsman's workshop of her world — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a forest path in her world — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds a cup at chest height; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — kneeling on the ground; a convention photo zone under ring lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — seated sideways on a stool or bench; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing
